items.title: Cripple a Scorched's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport and use V.A.T.S. to target the arm.

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Forest Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Deathclaw Island and fish any water source.

items.title: Collect Mothman Eggs
items.detail: Harvest from a C.A.M.P. Mothman Nest or find them at Point Pleasant.

items.title: Cook a Meat-Based Meal
items.detail: Cook any meat-based meal at a Cooking Station.

items.title: Kill a Brahmin
items.detail: Brahmin spawn reliably near Flatwoods and The Wayward.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Any outfit with 'Costume' in the description counts; they spawn near cabins and campgrounds.

items.title: Sell Mothman Egg Omelette to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Craft with one Mothman Egg and one wood, then sell at any NPC vendor.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Build basic wood or concrete floors at your C.A.M.P. or claimed workshop.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find and clear the marked Infestation hotspot for rare legendary loot.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; different sizes yield different amounts.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for robot spawns.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Eat pre-war food items or collect from C.A.M.P. machines like Weenie Wagon.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond for reliable spawn; target the eyes.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Kill masked cultists inside the Infestation hotspot encounter.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event and stay in the Vertibot area for spawns.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days this week.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a C.A.M.P. or Shelter inspired by classic slasher movies and submit to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantom encounters and special rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation chance during Daily Operations with new and seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Spooky-themed Scorched event with seasonal rewards and special encounters.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Double experience gain for normal gameplay and activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Improved chances to catch seasonal fish with new recipes and challenges.
